title: Knowing God
definition: Knowing God means personally and truly knowing Him as He has revealed Himself through Scripture and Jesus Christ.
summary: Knowing God is more than knowing facts about Him. It includes faith, worship, love, obedience, and relationship with Him.
christFocus: Jesus came so that people may know the Father and receive eternal life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Knowing God is more than knowing facts about Him. It includes faith, worship, love, obedience, and relationship with Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
